notes: This is the seed set merged into malware_signatures on first run. It is intentionally tiny.
The EICAR entry is the real, industry-standard antivirus test file hash. It is completely
harmless: the 68-byte ASCII string is not malicious code, it exists so scanners can be
verified. Create it with: printf '%s' "<the eicar string>" > eicar.com
The DEMO-SEED entries are NOT real malware intelligence. Each hash is the SHA-256 of the
plain ASCII string in its test_payload field, so you can generate a matching file and watch
the full detection -> classify -> quarantine -> timeline flow end to end. Real signature
intelligence is expected to arrive through core/antivirus/updater.py from updater.feed_url.
